scope: Source units and definitional domains, not universal normal ranges. Uploaded units are assumed to match source labels, never automatically converted.
sentinel_policy: No arbitrary numeric sentinel, including zero or -999, is silently treated as missing.

HR.domain_rationale: Nonnegative concentration, count, activity, duration, rate or absolute gas partial pressure.
HR.warning_note: No invented universal clinical reference interval. Frozen-training |z|>8 is a separate statistical-shift warning only.
HR.missing: Standard CSV blank/NaN; zero remains an observation.

O2Sat.domain_rationale: A fraction expressed as a percentage is bounded from 0 to 100.
O2Sat.warning_note: No invented universal clinical reference interval. Frozen-training |z|>8 is a separate statistical-shift warning only.
O2Sat.missing: Standard CSV blank/NaN; zero remains an observation.

Temp.domain_rationale: Absolute-zero lower bound expressed in the source Celsius convention; not a clinical plausibility range.
Temp.warning_note: No invented universal clinical reference interval. Frozen-training |z|>8 is a separate statistical-shift warning only.
Temp.missing: Standard CSV blank/NaN; zero remains an observation.
Temp.unit_note: Official source expects degrees Celsius. A user CSV does not establish its temperature unit; no Fahrenheit conversion or clinical thresholds are applied automatically.
